checker: complete-confirmation-condition-v1; complete source and complete Chinese only; replace only refund-condition-unverified on exact matching event, relation and polarity; every other rejection retained
chineseGrammar: [在]确认(前|之前|以前|后|之后|以后)(可退款|可以退款|允许退款|可退还|可以退还|不可退款|不能退款|不予退款|不退款|无法退款|不允许退款|不可退还|不能退还)[。|.]
context: Every raw candidate once, sorted spatially, joined by newline; no deduplication
join: Single LF between unmodified member strings
qualification: Unique pair; no intervening same-column item or overlap competitor. Original reasons empty or sole NON_AXIS_ALIGNED, independently near-horizontal. Original diagnostics retained. Ambiguous connected relations retain all members.
requestSentenceSplitting: nonewlines: preserve raw LF in one complete text; never split the visual line wrap

syntax.normalization: accent/case match only; exact spaces; never rewrite raw

unsupported: only/unless/except, suffixes, double negation, contradictory clauses, missing or changed event/relation/polarity
